title: How to Clean Vitrified Tile Floors at Home Without Dullness or Residue
description: Learn a simple way to clean vitrified tile floors, reduce residue and keep everyday mopping efficient without using excessive cleaner.
content:
Vitrified tiles are popular because they are durable and relatively easy to maintain. Yet a floor can still look dull or streaky if dust is not removed first, too much cleaner is used or dirty water is repeatedly spread across the surface.

Start by removing loose dirt

Sweep or vacuum the floor before wet mopping. Pay extra attention to entrances, balconies and other places where sand and dust enter the home. Removing loose particles first makes wet cleaning more effective.

Use a suitable floor cleaner

Choose a cleaner whose label indicates that it is suitable for your flooring. If dilution is required, measure or estimate carefully according to the instructions. Avoid assuming that a stronger solution gives better results.

Use a clean mop

A dirty mop can leave a film on an otherwise clean floor. Rinse the mop regularly and wash it after cleaning. Allow the mop to dry between uses.

Avoid excessive water

Vitrified tiles themselves are generally hard-wearing, but water can still collect in grout lines, edges and around furniture. Use enough moisture to clean the floor without leaving unnecessary standing water.

Why does a floor look cloudy after mopping?

Possible causes include excess cleaning product, dirty water, residue from previous products or an unsuitable cleaner. Try improving the cleaning process before adding more chemicals. If a residue is suspected, follow the flooring or product manufacturer's cleaning guidance.

How often should you mop?

There is no universal schedule. High-traffic rooms and homes with pets or children may need more frequent cleaning. Low-traffic rooms can usually be cleaned less often. A quick dry clean can be useful between wet-mopping sessions.

Do not use toilet cleaner on the floor unless specified

Toilet cleaners are formulated for toilet-cleaning applications and may not be suitable for flooring. Use a product according to its label and check compatibility with the surface.

Never mix cleaning products

Avoid combining floor cleaners with toilet cleaners, bleach or other household chemicals unless the manufacturer specifically confirms the combination is safe.

Mr Glowra for everyday floor care

Mr Glowra floor-cleaning products can be part of a regular home-cleaning routine when used according to their labels. Select the appropriate product for your surface and follow the recommended directions.

A better-looking vitrified floor does not require an elaborate routine. Sweep first, use the correct amount of a suitable cleaner, keep the mop and water clean, avoid excess water and give the floor time to dry.
